Name: FV - Mossy Animals AT Retexture
Author: Anthri
Description:
[u][center]Fantasy Valley Series Mod[/center][/u]
An [b]unfinished[/b] alternative textures pack for the farm animals. Gives them a mossier and earthy look - made for use with an earthy recolor (I use DaisyNiko's) and goes well with my other Fantasy Valley (FV) mod!

Currently has a mossy horse, coop, and barn animals.
I'm planning to add mossy pet variants.


- ! NEW ! -
Barn animals! Including the ostrich.

Enjoy!

[i]
You will need alternative textures for this
If you encounter any issues please message me - I don't check the posts often
All mod screenshots use DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
[b]Do Not repost without my permission[/b] - if you have any changes you want to see ask me![/i]
[center]

[u]Check out my other Fantasy Valley Mod![/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7744][AT] Wizard's Wares[/url]﻿[/center]
